description:
South of the Boulevard in Tarzana for $1,625,000 — an opportunity that feels almost too good to be true. This beautifully maintained single-story residence offers 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and approximately 2,538 sq ft of light-filled living space on an expansive 16,577 sq ft private lot with a sparkling pool and spa.
Tucked away from the street for ultimate privacy, this home immediately impresses with its sense of space, warmth, and timeless California character. Soaring ceilings, oversized rooms, and a dramatic wall of windows invite natural light to pour in throughout the day, creating a bright, airy, and uplifting atmosphere. Multiple sliding glass doors extend the living experience outdoors, blending interior comfort with true Southern California indoor-outdoor living.
The flowing floor plan is ideal for both elegant entertaining and everyday ease, featuring generous formal living and dining spaces, a welcoming family room, and an updated kitchen that opens to a comfortable eat-in area. The primary suite is a peaceful retreat with tranquil pool views, direct backyard access, and a spacious en-suite bath designed for relaxation. A thoughtfully separated bedroom and bathroom off the kitchen offers exceptional flexibility for guests, a private office, or multigenerational living.
Outdoors, the property transforms into a private resort-style escape. Lush landscaping surrounds the pool and spa, while expansive grounds provide multiple areas for lounging, entertaining, and enjoying the quiet hillside setting.
Perfectly positioned just moments from Mulholland Hills Country Club(formally known as Braemar), shopping, dining, and everyday conveniences, this exceptional Tarzana Hills home delivers the lifestyle buyers are searching for — space, privacy, light, and location — all in one rare South of the Boulevard offering.
This is the one you wait for.
